item.goal: Fix backend/app/domains/audit/service.py so that check_detail accepts token COUNT fields: any key ending in _tokens (input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, total_tokens, reasoning_tokens, max_tokens, ...) with a value is not a secret. Do it as a rule (e.g. the _KEY_OK_SUFFIX pattern), not a list of names. Secret-named fields must still raise AuditError: token, access_token, api_key, refresh_token, password with a non-empty string value.
